youtube.title: Why Supermarkets Put Milk at the Back of the Store (Since 1916)
youtube.description:
Why do supermarkets put milk at the back of the store? The cold room and delivery dock are only part of the answer. The grocery store layout began with Clarence Saunders' Piggly Wiggly patent in 1916, and the shopping cart made it pay by walking you past every shelf.
